segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine selection
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth,
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large 'me',
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu.

segments.text_en: First dream command and epistemic uncertainty
evidence: "Build his house!," he ordered him.
Of what my 'dark goat' has revealed to me, / its 'heart' I did not know.
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother.
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, / may she make its meaning visible for me.

segments.text_en: River journey and prayer at Bagara
evidence: Towards Nina, her city, on Ininadua, he directed the barge,
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water,
Ningirsu, let me build your house for you, / let me make the 'me' perfect for you.
From Gudea, his offering and his prayer, his king, / the lord Ningirsu, received from him.

segments.text_en: Supplication and filial appeal to Gatumdu
evidence: I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother.
You are a broad parasol, under your shade / let me cool myself there.
may your good Utukku go in front of me, / may your good Lamma follow me on my path.
Shiny-Gatumdu received from Gudea.

segments.text_en: Arrival at Nina and recounting the nocturnal vision
evidence: Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven,
He spoke to me about the building of his house. / His 'heart' I did not understand.
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand. / She had the tablet of the stars on her lap.
he bent the arm, he held a lapis writing board in the hand, / he drew the plan of the house.

segments.text_en: Nanše's hermeneutic decoding and ritual instructions
evidence: My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you.
it is surely my brother Ningirsu. / 'Build his shrine, the Eninnu!' He ordered you.
after you have decorated this chariot with purified silver and lapis,
The 'heart' of the lord, distant like the heavens, / of Ningirsu, son of Enlil, he will calm for you.

segments.text_en: Execution of instructions and presentation of gifts
evidence: He broke the seal of his treasure house, / he brought out wood.
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, / he wrote his name on it.
With his beloved harp, 'dragon of the land', / the famous roaring wood, with which he councels,
Joyfully he entered to him in the house.

segments.text_en: Second incubation prayer and request for a clear sign
evidence: He rose for his king in public, he prayed to him,
Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, / (but) my sign is my not.
your 'heart', surging, like the ocean, / your, receding, like the wave,
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, 'heart', / son of Enlil, lord Ningirsu, / I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Direct divine revelation and cosmic covenant of Ningirsu
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house.
Its terrible radiance reaches the heaven. / The big fear of my house is spread on all the lands.
With the founding of my house, / may abundance arrive.
I will build the house for you at day, / at night I will let it grow for you.

segments.text_en: Awakening, extispicy, moral purification of the city
evidence: He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good.
He returned 'sin' to its house. / He loosened the tongue of the whip
The governor cleansed the city, / he spun it with fire.
He laid down the goat by the box, the mold, / he made the brick appear by the goat

segments.text_en: Universal levy of Lagash and submission of foreign nations
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land, / in the totality of all of his lands.
Its mighty emblem, 'the king crushes the foreign lands', standing at the head.
Elam came to him from Elam. / Susa came to him from Susa.
For the construction of Ningirsu’s house, / they assembled for Gudea in his city Girsu.

segments.text_en: Opening of cosmic pathways and procurement of raw materials
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, / for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu / made way for him.
He cut down its cedars with the great axe.
To the land of stone, where no man enters, / Gudea for the Lord Ningirsu / made way for him.
Purified silver is being brought down for Gudea from its mountain.

segments.text_en: Architectural alignment, vigilance, and ritual procession
evidence: Concerning the building of his king’s house, / he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight,
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, / she opened for him. / Enki made the plan of the house right for him.
The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies, / he raised to Eninnu.
Lugalkurdub went in front of him, / Igalim places the road for him, / (and) Ningešzida, his god, / leads him by the hand.

segments.text_en: Ritual molding and elevation of the first brick
evidence: He greased it with honey, butter oil, and fine butter oil.
Gudea placed clay in the mold. / The cultic order emerged.
(About) his brick placed in the mold, / Utu was pleased with it.
he lifted the brick from the mold, / it is a shiny throne raised to heaven.

segments.text_en: Vigilance, nocturnal verification, and final omen
evidence: Like a cow whose eye are on its calf, / he walked to the house in great concern.
he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good.
Gudea lying by the top, / he slept, the word dawned on him.
the separation of Eninnu from heaven and earth, / was brought to his attention.

segments.text_en: Divine participation and sevenfold blessing of foundations
evidence: Enki places the foundation of the house,
The mother of Lagash, Shiny-Gatumdu, / bore its bricks in flows.
he placed the foundation, the wall touched the ground, / he gave a blessing, he stroked the brick with flax.
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house? / It is Eninnu—Moon passing (through)—filling the land.

segments.text_en: Erection of walls, cedar roofing, and cosmic anchoring
evidence: They make the house grow like a mountain. / They make it float in the middle of the heaven like a cloud.
The house raised the head to heaven like a mountain in heaven and earth.
he placed the very large mast, the foundation, its Abzu, in the ground.
He placed the 'multitude-eraser', like a great sign, with Lagash / He placed it in Šugalam, its terrible place

segments.text_en: Erection and naming of monumental stelas
evidence: His stone erected in the mighty courtyard, / 'the stela, king filling the courtyard,
His stone erected in Kasurra, / 'the king, flood of Enlil,
His stone erected in front of Šugalam, / 'by the name of his king the mountains tremble,
His stone erected in Baba's back-room, / 'Eninnu, knowing the face of An, / Baba, life of Gudea,'

segments.text_en: Cosmic elevation, radiant aesthetics, and sacred banqueting
evidence: The righteous shepherd Gudea made it grow together with heaven and earth.
made it grow like a mountain of Lapis, / like a white alabaster mountain,
They prepare the meal in the great sanctuary, / it is gold bowls filled with honey and wine,
He built, and after he had finished it, / it is the 'heart' of the gods, returned to its banks.

segments.text_en: Installation of slain hero trophies and warrior emblems
evidence: At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, / Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, / he seizes there.
At Šugalam, the gate of radiance, / the dragon and the date palm he seizes there.
Because they are dead warriors, / he placed their mouths at the libation place,
(and) their names, in the midst of the gods, / Gudea, governor of Lagash, / made them emerge.

segments.text_en: Installing cosmic hardware, gates, and protective aura
evidence: The cedar doors standing in the house, / it is Iškur roaring from heaven.
The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands, / like a garment, it covered.
The house, founded by Anu with purified silver, / decorated with good perfume,
Its king, Lord Ningirsu, / chose it in his shiny 'heart', / he poured it on top like good incense.

segments.text_en: Establishment of storehouses, breweries, and sacred facilities
evidence: From the mighty oven, / large cakes, large croissants(!?).
The wine-cellar(?) / (called) 'mountain dripping with wine'.
From the brewery, / (called) 'Tigris is being water in its might'.
In the treasury, precious stones, silver, tin.

segments.text_en: Final temple manifestation and concluding doxology
evidence: The big fear of the house / rests on the land. / Its praise / reaches the mountains.
Gudea, governor of Lagash, / placed its foundation.
like a green mountain / clad in joy, / --standing to be admired.
For the restoration of Eninnu / Ningirsu be praised!
